batch.topic: A diner wants a small portion of the same dish rather than a different children’s dish; preserve the requested portion and identity.
A cook places sliced mushrooms on a tray without piling them up; preserve the purpose without inventing an exact cooking temperature.
A customer asks whether the drink is unsweetened or sweetened with another ingredient; no added sugar does not imply no sugar.
A baker lets a pastry case cool before adding a cold filling; distinguish pastry shell from whole dessert and preserve timing.
